claims.statement: Static exercise blocks without a feedback loop should not remain as duplicated learning activities on a self-study platform.
Use three distinct layers: Micro-Practice in Learning Workspace, Practice Room for fluency/self-correction, and Readiness Check for end-of-topic assessment.
Readiness assessment should score only after final submission and may use a dedicated static-site JavaScript component.

proposed_changes.change: Keep micro-practice inline and remove duplicated static practice/self-test blocks.
proposed_changes.rationale: Reduce overlap and restore clear feedback loop.

proposed_changes.change: Use written problems with collapsible solutions.
Create end-of-topic assessment scored only after submission.
proposed_changes.rationale: Separate summative evidence from formative practice.

uncertainties: Static GitHub Pages needs a reusable client-side readiness engine.

acceptance.notes: Integrated with Practice Engine retained, Soft Mastery preserved, assessment evidence separated from practice evidence, and no hard Knowledge Graph unlock.
